about_short_description.short_description: Solaris AI develops SaaS operations and maintenance system designed for solar farms and large-scale photovoltaic installations.

product.name: O&M Platform
product.description: A comprehensive dashboard providing a holistic view of data and key performance indicators for decision-making in solar farm operations.

product.name: Cloud-Based SaaS Services
product.description: Cloud-based operations and maintenance platforms that integrate with customer monitoring services, accessible from any network-connected device.

product.name: Customer Integrated SaaS Services
product.description: Cloud-based solutions that integrate with other applications and systems to streamline operations and enhance collaboration.

product.name: Customer Data Analysis Reports
product.description: Reports providing insights into customer data, delivered at flexible intervals to meet business needs.

product.name: Predictive Maintenance Using AI
product.description: A tool that uses AI to provide proactive insights for optimized equipment performance and minimize downtime.

product.name: Customer Data Prefiltering Software
product.description: Software that pre-cleans customer site data to enhance data accuracy and quality.
